E2_inner_overlap_and_both_unseen.value: assertions passed for all 50 outer folds: inner-held disjoint from inner-train drugs; inner-validation rows have both drugs in inner-held

E3_unified_inner_metric.value: grouped and row-level both use the mean of the 3 per-inner-fold Spearman values; scaler fitted inside each inner training fold (see record_r196_v2.md)

value.note: test labels are read only in the scoring step; lambda selection and prediction generation receive a training-only label view whose non-training entries are NaN (asserted finite wherever used)

c130_reference_not_a_comparison_interval.note: C130 used 40 overlapping random splits and row-level inner tuning with lambda<=1000; this amendment uses 10 independent drug partitions, drug-grouped inner tuning and lambda<=10000. Its CI is NOT a reference interval for this audit.

capacity_contrast.note: descriptive zero-model specificity contrast; capacity was run on partition 0 only

judgment.delta_min_operational: rho=0.05 <=> Kendall tau=(2/pi)asin(0.05)=0.0318 <=> ~1.59 pp higher chance of correctly ordering a random pair of unseen combinations; a reliability minimum, not a utility threshold

fold_dispersion_formal_sensitivity.note: formal sensitivity (AMENDMENT section 4/6); primary inference uses the drug-cluster bootstrap, not this t-interval

h196b.note: H196b is a reliability qualifier only; it does not change the pre-registered verdict rule (AMENDMENT section 5). Both schemes now use the identical fold-mean inner metric; the c130-grid variants are the C130 bridge.

judgment.primary_estimator: mean of 50 fold-level gains (10 partitions x 5 folds)
judgment.primary_unit: held-out drugs (10 independent drug partitions; drug-cluster bootstrap)
judgment.stability_band: no upper bound (AMENDMENT section 5); large_gain_flag recorded only
judgment.verdict_rule: inconclusive if primary MDE80>delta_min or any design check fails; replicated if primary drug-cluster CI lower>0 and point>=delta_min and MDE80<=delta_min and design checks pass; weakened otherwise

wording_template.inconclusive: may not be written as a negative result; only as "underpowered at the audit target unit / design check failed, unresolved"
wording_template.replicated_under_audit: allowed only as: within AMENDMENT-001, the fixed 10 drug partitions and the declared primary unit (held-out drugs), the both-unseen gain point estimate is >=delta_min with drug-cluster CI lower>0 and primary MDE80<=delta_min; must be reported together with the drug CI/MDE and partition/fold dispersion; no claim of C130 replication/confirmation/magnitude recovery/decision use
wording_template.weakened: may not be written as C130 refuted or annotation useless; only as "did not meet the audit-level minimum standard under this protocol"
